notes.title: 🔧 UI Update Live! Spinner: Rogueblade Demo Updated
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Spinner warriors! 🌀
A new user interface (UI) update has arrived for the Spinner: Rogueblade demo. We've revamped everything from menus to in-game experience based on your feedback.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648783/900b8ac558dafa7f31f4cf5c4b649e01db5bcbda.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🖥️ What's Changed?[/h3][list][*][p][b]Modern and Theme-Appropriate Menu Design:[/b]
With brand new visuals and animations, everything now fits better with the Spinner: Rogueblade universe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Detailed Settings Menu:[/b]
We've gone beyond the old plain menu. Explore more options from sound and music levels to graphics. (It might still be basic, but it's improving!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Support in Main Menu:[/b]
You can now navigate menus with a gamepad. We're one step closer to that console feel![/p][/*][*][p][b]More Intuitive In-Game UI:[/b]
Health, energy, and character icons are now clearer and more functional.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ These improvements came thanks to your feedback. Keep sharing your ideas during the demo process — because we're shaping this world together.[/p][p]💬 We're waiting for your comments!
🧡 Thank you for your support![/p]
